description: a blind review of a JavaScript branch with four planted defects, the same four kinds as review-planted

planted.what: pages start at 1, so page 1 skips the first ten notes
each listed note's file descriptor is opened and never closed
read joins the name unchecked, so ../ escapes the notes directory
import buffers the whole stream before the 1 MiB check, so a huge note is held in memory
